mean_cn: n.角落，角；困境；边远地区，偏僻住所；  v.将……逼入困境
mean_en: a part of something where two or more sides, lines or edges join; the place inside a room or a box where two sides join; the area around this place
sentence: The little boy unhappily sat in the corner of the room.
sentence_trans: 小男孩不高兴地坐在房间的角落里。
word_etyma: corn角，头 + er名词后缀，人或物 → corner角落
